name: Corona
author: Erin Carter
description: An absolute-black void disc betrayed only by its rim: dozens of curved hairline filaments hugging the circumference like corona discharge at an eclipse's edge, drifting slowly around the circuit while each streak flickers on its own phase — and at long intervals one erupts into a streamer that detaches and dissolves into the dark.

params.label: Disc size
params.effect: Diameter of the black void disc in CSS pixels; the filament rim scales with it.

params.label: Flicker speed
params.effect: Rate of the per-filament brightness and length phases and of the rim's slow circumferential drift, from glacial smoulder to nervous shimmer.

params.label: Filament reach
params.effect: Maximum radial length the filaments extend beyond the rim in CSS pixels — a tight bright band at min, long searching streamers reaching toward the corners at max.

params.label: Filament density
params.effect: How many filaments ring the circumference — a sparse spiky crown at min, a dense continuous corona fur at max.

params.label: Turbulence
params.effect: How much the filaments writhe — curl, sway and length-swell amplitude. 0 is a calm radial fringe, 1 a roiling, agitated discharge.

params.label: Eruption rate
params.effect: How often a filament erupts into a long detaching streamer; 0 disables eruptions entirely, 1 keeps one arcing free somewhere most of the time.

params.label: Position X
params.effect: Slides the eclipse disc left or right, in short-axis units, so it can sit off-centre in the frame.

params.label: Position Y
params.effect: Slides the eclipse disc up or down, in short-axis units.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: How thickly stars fill the surrounding sky — 0 an empty void, 1 a crowded field.

params.label: Star glow
params.effect: Brightness of the stars; 0 puts out the sky, high makes them blaze.

params.label: Star colour
params.effect: Star tint — 0 dyes them with the palette like distant nebulae, 1 burns them to pure white.

params.label: Star twinkle
params.effect: Twinkle rate of the stars; 0 freezes them to a still field, high sets the whole sky shimmering.
